verdict.rationale: Extend has a first-party CLI documentation page (docs.extend.ai/cli), and a probe confirmed that the official CLI is documented there, so the core of the story is met. The evidence shows only that the page exists, though: none of its content is in the pack, so we cannot see what the CLI does or how it supports agentic workflows. Missing for 10: details of CLI commands and capabilities, install/auth instructions for the CLI, evidence of agent-oriented CLI features, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI usage.
